newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Nov 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Nov 6.

text.p: The following is a summary of major South Korean political stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not gaurantee their accuracy. Telephone: (822) 727-5650. Fax: (822) 727-5666.
- Foreign Minister Gong Ro-myoung submits resignation in a surprise move, citing health problems. President Kim Young-sam is expected to appoint new minister today.
- Two North Korean guerrillas were shot and killed, while three South Korean soldiers, including an army colonel, were killed in the encounter.
- Share prices tumbled yesterday for secound straight day, with the composite index nosediving to three-year low.
- South Korean commanders responsible for faulty operations against North Korean infiltrators are to be discharged or courtmartialed, according to defense minister Kim Dong-jin.
- Two North Korean agents killed in shootout while three South Korean soldiers die.
- Stock market continues to lose ground.
- Army troops shot to death two of the remaining three North Korean infiltrators.
